comment: In the Basic OP and Form Post Basic plans; the Config OP plan has no such module. pulsar has one authentication level and never returns acr, since claiming one would be untrue (#11, REQ-CORE-26). acr_values requests acr as a Voluntary Claim, and the minimum support OpenID Connect Core 1.0 §15.1 requires is that its use not result in an error, which the module checks first.

Form Post Basic plan only; see the failures of this module in expected-failures.json. The discovery document lists request_parameter_supported as false, so the warning is accurate: pulsar supports no request objects.
